scoring_justification: Coefficients and susceptibilities compared to paper reported values with tolerances. Full recomputation from raw DFT data is infeasible within the checker sandbox, but result‑level comparison against known paper gold is acceptable.

schema.description: Fitted polynomial coefficients for in-plane potential and dipole of monolayer hBN.

outputs.description: Fitted coefficients e0, e1, e2, p̄0, Q0, Q1, Q2 in atomic units from DFT data.

schema.description: Perturbative nonlinear susceptibilities and DC-field-induced resonance shift.

outputs.description: Nonlinear susceptibilities χ^(1), χ^(2), χ^(3) at resonance and DC shift for E_DC=10^9 V/m.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares each reported value against the paper's reference values using relative tolerances and absolute tolerance for the DC shift. The reward is based on the fraction of values within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for coefficients and susceptibilities from paper Table I and text
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's reported coefficients (sec. II) and Table I
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the published paper; units as stated.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the published paper.
